content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Makes street sweepers, mowers and farm equipment, not buses; shares municipal customers but a different product business."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Roofing membranes, insulation and coatings for construction; brake parts are a minor line, not school-bus manufacturing."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Construction products, HVAC components and industrial valves; no bus manufacturing or fleet vehicle business."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Replacement auto and truck parts sold to aftermarket retailers; target is a bus OEM, not an aftermarket parts supplier."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Heating, cooling and refrigeration equipment sold to contractors and homeowners; unrelated to vehicle manufacturing."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Recreational wakeboard and ski boats sold to consumers through dealers; a different product and customer base."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Roofing shingles, insulation and glass fiber for building markets; no vehicle or bus manufacturing overlap."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Precision bearings for aerospace and defense OEMs; a component supplier, not a vehicle or bus builder."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Locks, keys and latches supplied to automakers for vehicle programs; a vehicle component supplier, not a bus OEM."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Turf equipment, irrigation and snow throwers sold to landscapers and homeowners; different products and customers."},{"label":"C11","good":true,"reason":"Builds buses from purchased chassis for public transit and fleet buyers via dealers; main business is RVs, so it is an imperfect match."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Railcar manufacturing, leasing and guardrail products for railroads and agencies; different vehicles and customers."}]}
